method: Read already-produced capture-2 JPEGs using view_image; no own GPU/CPU rendering.

observations.finding: New muted body/lid palette gives the two bins a legible top edge and calmer relationship to crate/shed. Existing clear door route preserved; dustpan remains mostly hidden.
Old arc/ring marks no longer visible on the right apartment wall, but grey blotches and dark dots still form prominent texture. Do not describe as refined fine grain.
Distant5Fsunlit wall shows noticeable repeated dark blotches between floor divisions; this competes with architectural form.
The5Fgrey wall reads more strongly mottled over its large area; warm4Fwall also has noticeable blotches. Existing housekeeping/door/stair arrangement unchanged; parcels remain behind parapet.
Existing meter/pipe remains legible, porch/shopfront unchanged to visual inspection; no new obstruction. Pixel equivalence is not asserted by this visual review.

recommendation: Return a focused visual request to C: reduce map contrast only in a separate apartment-wall material that reuses the existing texture. Preserve wall base tones, structural light/shadow and current global lighting; do not modify shared M.concrete or cap/prop materials. Further UV scaling alone does not address contrast.
limits: A local art refinement, not a functional/physics failure or proof the whole scene is accepted.
Texture contains blotches/speckles and thin seam lines; CPU does not prove perceived dirtiness. This judgment is from listed real-material local GPU images.
Static images cannot establish all camera movement/depth stability; geometric side-gap proof is in separate CPU audit.
